Scholarship Programs
IsDB Scholarship Program Booklets
The Scholarship booklets are essential resources for students interested in applying for the IsDB Scholarship Program. These booklets offer detailed and comprehensive information about the various scholarships available, including eligibility criteria, partner institutions, fields of study, benefits, facilities, and recipient obligations.
By consolidating all relevant information in one place, IsDB Scholarship Booklets provide students with a centralized and convenient source, simplifying the process of discovering and accessing scholarship opportunities without the need for extensive research.
For the Scholarship Program for Muslim Communities in Non-Member Countries,
the list of eligible countries for the year 2025-2026 includes:: Australia, Cambodia, Croatia, Ethiopia, Fiji, Ghana, India, Kenya, Liberia, Macedonia, Madagascar, Mauritius, Myanmar, Namibia, Nepal, Netherlands, Republic of Congo, Russian Federation, Rwanda, Singapore, South Africa, Sri Lanka, Tanzania, Thailand, The Philippines, Trinidad-Tobago, Vietnam, and Zambia.
